mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_inventory WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_inventory WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_inventory WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT i.* FROM t_inventory i INNER JOIN t_material m ON i.material_id = m.id WHERE i.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND i.quantity < m.safety_stock ORDER BY i.quantity ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM t_inventory WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_inventory (warehouse_id, location_id, material_id, lot_id, quantity, last_update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{locationId}, #{materialId}, #{lotId}, #{quantity}, #{lastUpdateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_inventory SET warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, location_id = #{locationId}, material_id = #{materialId}, lot_id = #{lotId}, quantity = #{quantity}, last_update_time = #{lastUpdateTime}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE t_inventory SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
